audio.strategy: One basic piano voice produced by honest real-time synthesis in a single Web Audio AudioContext. Each note is a small additive oscillator stack (a triangle fundamental, a slightly detuned sine for body, and sine partials at the octave and twelfth) shaped by a per-note gain envelope. Velocity scales the peak gain on a squared curve; note-off applies a per-note linear release; sustain (UI/keyboard/MIDI CC64) holds released notes until the damper lifts. All voices route through one master gain into a DynamicsCompressor acting as a soft limiter, then to the single AudioContext.destination. Polyphony is bounded (16 voices) with deterministic oldest-first voice stealing. There are NO recorded samples in this phase.

generatedSources.name: Phase 1 basic piano voice
generatedSources.synthesis: Additive oscillator stack (triangle fundamental + detuned sine + octave/twelfth sine partials) with a velocity-scaled amplitude envelope and per-note release.
generatedSources.license: Generated at runtime; no third-party asset, no license required.
generatedSources.notes: This is synthesized, not a recording. It is a deliberately simple, dependable placeholder for the Phase 2 recorded sample sets (Grand/Upright/Electric), which are NOT present yet.

notes: No recorded sample sets are bundled in Phase 1. Grand/Upright/Electric recorded sample sets are Phase 2 scope.
The audio boundary is injectable (src/audio/types.ts). Tests use src/audio/fakeBackend.ts — no real AudioContext, no audio output, no network, no MIDI device.
If no AudioContext is available, the app enters a truthful, labeled silent 'fallback' status that still tracks the note lifecycle and never reports the primary voice as ready.

Every panel control other than the keybed and sustain input is honestly decorative: it moves/presses and stores presentation-only state (src/state/controlStore.ts). No decorative control produces audio or mutates program/effect/system state (honesty contract).

decorativeControls.summary: All panel controls outside the keybed are decorative in Phase 1. They have stable IDs, accessible names/roles/values, respond to pointer and keyboard, and show state (buttons light, knobs turn, faders/drawbars slide, selectors cycle). None affects audio or system state.

functional.keybed: 73 keys (E1..E7), pointer + independent multi-touch + accessible computer keyboard + Web MIDI note/velocity + CC64 sustain, through one shared note lifecycle (src/input/noteRouter.ts).
functional.sustainInput: UI is not a functional Phase 1 requirement; sustain is functional from computer-keyboard-independent MIDI CC64 and the router API. The SUSTPED panel toggles are decorative in Phase 1.
